mentions.name: Server Radar
mentions.description: This app is a price tracker for the Hetzner Auction, featuring dark mode, sorting, grouping, layout improvements, and a drawer with an auction view. It also includes a Cloud Server Availability page that reports Hetzner Cloud resource availability, added after people on /r/hetzner complained about a lack of resources.
mentions.problem: People on /r/hetzner complained about a lack of Hetzner Cloud resources, prompting the Cloud Server Availability page.
mentions.source_excerpt: Worked a little on Server Radar [1] again, the Hetzner Auction price tracker.
